entries.EN:
Barkeep: "According to the documents you brought from Agroprom, things are starting to clear up, but some data is missing. There is evidence to suggest the presence of a Brain Scorcher which blocks the road to the North, but no one knows exactly what it is. Also, there is mention of Lab X-18 whose description matches that of abandoned underground structures in the Dark Valley. Its present activity is unknown and besides, bandits have now set up their base in the Dark Valley. 
 
Several Duty scouts went there very recently, but so far there is no news from them. 
 
To get inside the lab, you will need two electronic keys; one of them was already in the briefcase, but the second one was at the Dark Valley and it is likely now in possession of Borov, the leader of the bandit gang that occupied the key's last known location. 
 
So, you need to locate the second key, most likely somewhere in the bandit base or on Borov himself, then get inside that lab and get the documents."
entries.JA_current:
バーキープ「アフロプロムから持ち帰った書類で、少しずつ状況が見えてきた。だが、まだ情報が足りない。北への道を塞ぐブレイン・スコーチャーが存在するらしいが、正体は誰にも分からない。ラボX18という研究所の記述もある。その特徴は、ダークバレーの放棄された地下施設と一致している。今も稼働しているかは不明だ。それに、あそこは今やバンディットの拠点になっている。 
 
つい最近もデューティーの偵察隊が数人向かったが、まだ連絡はない。 
 
研究所へ入るには電子キーが2つ必要だ。1つは例のケースに入っていた。もう1つはダークバレーにあったが、その場所を占拠しているバンディットのボス、ボロフが持っている可能性が高い。 
 
まずは2つ目の鍵を探せ。バンディット基地か、ボロフ本人が持っているはずだ。それを手に入れて研究所に入り、書類を持ち帰ってくれ」

entries.EN: A week ago it was decided to increase the intensity of radiation on the test subjects. No changes were detected in the first few days. After several days strange metamorphoses started to occur: hair loss, heightened aggressiveness. Several subjects were literally torn apart by their fellows.

entries.EN: Subjects' condition has stabilized. The amount of hair is now 10% of the original amount. Their claws and teeth have grown to abnormally large proportions. Bursts of activity exhibit seemingly random behavior and are no longer directed at their peers. Senior lab technician A.N. Burnov speculated that this may indicate an increase in the subjects' intellect. It was decided to test the new modulation of psi-emissions on the subjects.

entries.EN: Chief of Security: Yesterday security guard G.P. Glebov tossed a piece of meat to the subjects just for fun. They tore apart and devoured it in mere seconds. Subsequently several individuals tried to break out of the cells. Because of this, lab technicians were unable to obtain the necessary test samples. Although G.P. Glebov's actions were ill-considered, I propose that maintenance personnel be equipped with airguns for adequate protection in the event of emergencies.

entries.EN: Chief of Security: Yesterday the experiment almost got out of control. Two dozen test subjects broke out and vandalized two laboratory rooms. Fortunately, the research personnel were able to lock themselves up upstairs. We were ordered to clear the main laboratory room. In the course of the operation, three guards suffered bites. Hopefully, they will be OK. I hope the experiment will yield significant results soon.

entries.EN: Yesterday we delivered a new modulation of psi-emissions to the test subjects. It appeared as though their brains were simply roasted. I can hardly imagine how this emission would affect humans. We have tested every type of emission and the results match those obtained in other laboratories. The experiment can now be considered complete. Presumably, in one week's time, we will be ready to conduct the experiment on larger creatures.

entries.EN: I had a strange dream. The colossal Chernobyl power plant emerges in the twilight. Everything looks peaceful. A lonely man appears. I see him from behind against the background of the plant. The wind starts to blow. Suddenly hordes of rats begin to skitter away from the station in all directions. The man, with his back still turned to me, shoots at the rats. There is an abrupt scream: "Strelok!". The man shudders, freezes for a moment, then starts to turn slowly in my direction, but... just an instant before I am to get a glance at his face, I wake up. What does this dream mean? I don't know, but I think it's something I have seen before.

entries.EN: Hell... Lab X-18 wasn't fun...and its current residents... I didn't think creatures like that even existed. I found some documents... I didn't understand much of what was written in there except that they contained technical specifications for some components for Kaymanov emitters. What's interesting is that the parts were destined for another lab with the codename X-16 and it's likely a secret facility as well.

entries.EN: The Zone presents more and more challenges. Why did the Captain need to send me and Trump alone to the Dark Valley, which is teeming with bandits, just before the start of the campaign to the North? No explanations, no guesses... The liaison was a reliable man, I trust him, and he could not have mixed up the orders. Well, we'll just sit here and hope the best. Goat's all right, he's got a muzzle almost like a real gangster, and they might take him for one of their own. I'm almost blind without my glasses, and I've got a big backpack digging into my shoulders. \Lately my health's been a little weak, too: my heart starts to ache when I work out. I remember during training sessions with the Captain, I almost reached the end of the planned route with full effort, when suddenly something prickled in my chest, darkened my eyes, my legs began to shake... I almost collapsed on the ground, when suddenly someone picked me up and dragged me further. I looked - and it's Crow, the stalker from the hunters, who helped our group. He dragged me to the end. The Captain had offered to go with us, but he refused and promised to lead the advance party to Dead City. \n\n %c[255,255,128,0]I went to check the old gas station, thinking there might still be gas left. I didn't find any gasoline, but I left some of the stuff there on the truck wreck, you jerk.%c[default]

entries.EN: Command is thinking, and we'll wait. Patience is the main trait of a stalker, it is the basis of his essence. Only a fool would jump at danger, relying on his own brute strength; a true stalker lurks in the shadows of the ruins, waits for the moment when the danger passes him and continues on his way. Enduring hardship is the basis of a strong essence, and the Zone respects patience and endurance. That's what my teacher used to say. \n\n %c[255,255,128,0]I decided to explore the outskirts of the bandit lair. I found some swamp with a pipe. I wanted to check it out, but I got bogged down in the swamp and could hardly pull my boots out. And I drowned my traveling bag anyway.%c[default]
